steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: record-out-of-tol
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const w = s.floorPlan.walls[0]; const drawn = Math.round(Math.hypot(w.end[0]-w.start[0], w.end[1]-w.start[1]) * 1000); s.setSiteMeasurement('wall', w.id, drawn + 35); return { id: w.id, drawn }; })()

steps.name: select-wall
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setPlanSelection({ type: 'wall', id: s.floorPlan.walls[0].id }); })()
